`Vector2(INFINITY, INFINITY)` is also incorrect. Assuming GDScript, it would be `Vector2(INF, INF)`. But, genuinely, these kinds of usage of peeve me a bunch because it could just as well be replaced by the existing constant.

```suggestion
				[b]Note:[/b] If the drag was initiated by a keyboard shortcut or [method accessibility_drag], [param at_position] is set to [constant Vector2.INF], and the currently selected item/text position should be used as the drag position.
```
This entire description smells old...
